findings: src/execution/aggregate_hashtable.cpp:757 adds one condition, layout_ptr->AllConstant(). It only narrows when the existing unpartitioned staging path is taken. Rows that skip staging go to partitioned_data, an append path that was already used for every other case, so both outcomes were already-tested code paths. Flush, Repartition, Count and ReinsertTuples handle an empty or unused unpartitioned_data the same way as before. I found no correctness risk from NULLs, spilling or parallel execution.

The condition depends on the row layout (fixed-width vs. heap-backed). It does not refer to tables, columns, literals or data sizes, so it is a general change. Its effect is limited to aggregates with VARCHAR or nested group keys.
Nit: the new line is missing a space in `new_entry_count /RadixPartitioning`. This is a formatting issue only.
